#include <stddef.h>

#endif

#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}
--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
--- camera ---
  // camera
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -5.0000f);
  glRotatef(20.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(30.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---

  static float grid = 15; // grid size @tune
  static float extent = 3; // grid extent @tune
  static float x, y, z, dydx, dydz, s; // vertex coords, surface slopes, palette mix in [0,1]
  static float cx, sx, cz, sz; // cached cos/sin(x*freq+t), cos/sin(z*freq+zPhase*t)
  static float amp = 0.4; // wave amplitude (peak |y|)
  static float freq = 2.5; // spatial frequency along x and z
  static float zPhase = 0.7; // z-axis time phase: z evolves slower than x (<1)
  // Animated surface: y = sin(freq*x + t) * cos(freq*z + zPhase*t) * amp
  // Drawn as a triangle strip per row with analytic per-vertex normals.

  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);

  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, GL_TRUE);
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1});
  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 30);

  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT3);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT2);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT1);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glShadeModel(GL_SMOOTH);
  for(i, 0, grid) {
    glBegin(GL_TRIANGLE_STRIP);
      for(j, 0, grid+1) {
        // row i (z fixed), step j across x; emit two vertices per j to feed the strip
        x = -extent/2 + extent*j/grid;
        cx = cos(x*freq + t);
        sx = sin(x*freq + t);
        z = -extent/2 + extent*i/grid;
        cz = cos(z*freq + zPhase*t);
        sz = sin(z*freq + zPhase*t);
        y = sx*cz*amp;
        // Analytic slopes dy/dx and dy/dz make the un-normalized surface
        // normal (-dy/dx, 1, -dy/dz); GL_NORMALIZE rescales it to unit length.
        dydx = amp*freq*cx*cz;
        dydz = -amp*freq*sx*sz;
        glNormal3f(-dydx, 1, -dydz);
        s = 0.5 + 0.5*y/amp;
        glColor3f(1 - 0.85*s, 0.35 + 0.2*s, 0.2 + 0.8*s); // CORAL -> AZURE
        glVertex3f(x, y, z);
        // second strip vertex: same x (cx/sx unchanged), but z stepped to row i+1
        z = -extent/2 + extent*(i + 1)/grid;
        cz = cos(z*freq + zPhase*t);
        sz = sin(z*freq + zPhase*t);
        y = sx*cz*amp;
        dydx = amp*freq*cx*cz;
        dydz = -amp*freq*sx*sz;
        glNormal3f(-dydx, 1, -dydz);
        s = 0.5 + 0.5*y/amp;
        glColor3f(1 - 0.85*s, 0.35 + 0.2*s, 0.2 + 0.8*s); // CORAL -> AZURE
        glVertex3f(x, y, z);
      }
    glEnd();
  }
